purpose: Replace worker-held human-verification waiting with mature provider session persistence plus Temporal durable waiting, while retaining only thin provider adapters and exact effect/evidence fences.

externalStandards.target: Browserless v2 current stable, exact OCI digest after qualification

externalStandards.role: human-in-the-loop durable wait and resume signal
externalStandards.target: Workflow state + Signal/Update; no worker reservation while awaiting a human

externalStandards.role: provider-native login protocol when the provider exposes CAS
externalStandards.target: thin adapter only; do not reinterpret CAS as OAuth
Authorization Code + PKCE; no browser-cookie extraction

externalStandards.role: carrier lifecycle and immutable image identity
externalStandards.target: existing Quadlet + exact OCI digest + canary/promotion transaction

nodes.label: ProviderIdentityProtocol
nodes.responsibility: Represent provider-native identity protocol (CAS, OAuth/OIDC where actually offered) without inventing a new login protocol.

nodes.label: HumanInteractionSurface
nodes.responsibility: Expose the exact headful display to an authorized human through loopback x11vnc/noVNC.

nodes.label: BrowserSessionCarrier
nodes.responsibility: Keep the exact browser session alive across client/worker lifetimes.
nodes.current: Latest Browserless OSS v2.56.7 is already deployed; live CDP probe shows Browserless.reconnect is not exposed in this OSS image.
nodes.target: systemd-owned Chrome for Testing 153 + custom user-data-dir + loopback native CDP; Playwright clients attach/detach without owning browser lifetime

nodes.label: DurableHumanWait
nodes.responsibility: Persist HUMAN_REQUIRED without retaining an Activity, Runtime Job, runner process, or carrier lease.
nodes.current: separate human-resume workflow plus provider-side bounded wait in self-hosted-vnc path
nodes.target: Temporal Workflow durable wait + exact Signal/Update-bound resume

nodes.label: ResumeAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Bind resume to exact effectId, promptDigest, endpoint/session identity and handoff digest before re-entering provider automation.

nodes.label: ProviderEffectFence
nodes.responsibility: Prove whether SEND was crossed and preserve UNKNOWN rather than redispatching blindly.

nodes.label: BrowserlessImageQualification
nodes.responsibility: Qualify and promote exact Browserless OCI digests through paired canary, Security reseal and digest-fenced promotion.

nodes.label: ExecutionReconciliation
nodes.responsibility: Converge missing/stale runner state through Runtime job.observe rather than DB edits or process killing.

nodes.label: AttachedHumanPolling
nodes.responsibility: Legacy wait_for_human_provider_admission loop that keeps Playwright attached and consumes execution capacity.

nodes.label: GenericHumanSessionRoute
nodes.responsibility: Expose generic human-assisted browser work as an explicit router capability backed by the systemd/CfT session carrier, rather than ad-hoc Browserless execution.
